pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū anācāraṃ ācaritvā aññāṇakena āpannāti jānantūti pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.3: idāneva kho mayaṃ jānāma ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vakkhanti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.6: idāneva kho mayaṃ jānāma ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.7: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadetha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.8: idāneva kho mayaṃ jānāma ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.11: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vakkhatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.12: idāneva kho mayaṃ jānāma ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.13: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.16: idāneva kho ahaṃ jānāmi ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.17: tañce bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvittikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne ko pana vādo bhiyyoti na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi yañca tattha āpattiṃ āpanno tañca yathādhammo kāretabbo uttariñcassa moho āropetabbo
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:1.18: tassa te āvuso alābhā tassa te dulladdhaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikarosīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.11: aññāṇakena āpannoti jānantūti pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.12: idāneva kho ahaṃ jānāmi ayampi kira dhammo suttāgato suttapariyāpanno anvaḍḍhamāsaṃ uddesaṃ āgacchatīti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.13: tañceti mohetukāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvittikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne ko pana vādo bhiyyoti na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi yañca tattha āpattiṃ āpanno tañca yathādhammo kāretabbo uttariñcassa moho āropetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.17: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikaroti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.18: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho itthannāmassa bhikkhuno mohaṃ āropeyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.21: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne na sādhukaṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikaroti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.23: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno mohassa āropanā so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc73:2.1.26: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
